arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import urllib.request
import json

# Fetch the page to find the image
req = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Principle_of_double_effect', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15)
html = resp.read().decode('utf-8')
# Find image references
import re
images = re.findall(r'(?:File:|img src=)[^\"\\s>]+', html)
for img in images[:20]:
    print(img)
" 2>&1
